preserved_relations.relation: An opaque runtime value is mediated by an interface before operations on its concrete representation.
preserved_relations.extent: The abstraction/dispatch relation survives removal of names, but a category-specific sub-interface is weaker than one entry point spanning all array categories.

preserved_relations.relation: An address-like selector is interpreted against a nested container to obtain a contained value.
preserved_relations.extent: The traversal/retrieval relation survives. A multi-step path is not yet the contract of one array index operation.

unsupported_target_conditions.condition: One common array entry point supports element access without repeated caller downcasts.
unsupported_target_conditions.missing_fact: Whether category selection and adapter dispatch occur behind a single get(index) interface, rather than requiring each caller to select and convert to a category-specific interface.

unsupported_target_conditions.condition: Primitive, text, and nested-list value categories have a usable return contract.
unsupported_target_conditions.missing_fact: A concrete return contract covering all three categories, including how nested values and category identity are represented; the packet supplies only retrieval existence.

countermodel.construction: Each opaque container can expose either a numeric accessor or a text accessor after the caller selects its category. A separate path walker retrieves opaque child objects from nested containers. No shared get(index) result spans numeric, text, and nested values.
countermodel.reason: Both supplied source relationships hold, yet callers still branch by category and no common cross-category return representation is defined.

checks.limits: Two structural correspondences can be stated without source identity. The packet cannot prove implementation availability, array-index semantics, return types, or cost. A hidden adapter could close the gap, but its existence is not given.

unsupported_target_conditions.condition: Variable-length offset width can exceed 32 bits.
unsupported_target_conditions.missing_fact: Evidence about the width and semantics of positions into variable-length buffers; wide integer element values provide no such guarantee.

unsupported_target_conditions.condition: The requested nested/variable-length buffers cross the required interface.
unsupported_target_conditions.missing_fact: An actual retained nested/variable-length buffer representation and compatible interface transfer. The stated reader skips the nested values.

countermodel.construction: A reader exactly preserves every 64-bit integer value, but stores any variable-length positions in a 32-bit unsigned array and drops every nested value. It exports only the flat integer buffer.
countermodel.reason: The reader satisfies both source statements while being unable to address a variable-length buffer position above 2^32-1 and unable to export skipped nested buffers.

checks.limits: The numeral describes different roles: payload precision versus buffer addressing. A later adapter or reread could introduce a new mechanism, but neither is supplied, and lost nested values cannot be recovered from the exported flat buffer alone.

independence_limit: Logical review of a source-anonymized packet by a separate same-model agent, not a human study or provider implementation test.
